name: Author can create a new SOP draft

planSteps.description: Sign in as alex.rivera@soply.test with password Soply123! (fill the Email and Password fields on /login and click 'Sign in')
Click the 'Create new SOP' button on the overview page
The draft editor loads with the heading 'Document a process'
Fill the SOP title field (input#sop-title) with 'TestSprite draft - ATS onboarding'

Fill the Body content textarea (textarea#sop-body) with 'Purpose
Standardize new hire onboarding in the recruiting team.

Steps
1. Create the employee record.
2. Assign the ATS workflow.'
A 'Saved ✓' banner appears with the text 'Your changes are stored on the server'
